# 🧱 Complete C Systems & Low-Level Architecture Track

Welcome to your full C learning workspace materialized with **Trak**.

## 📚 Comprehensive Module Index

| Module | Title | Key Topics Covered |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-compilation-pipeline` | **Compilation Pipeline** | 4 Compilation stages (Preprocessor, Compiler, Assembler, Linker), Makefile, GCC |
| `01-memory-layout-of-c-program` | **Process Memory Layout** | Text, Data, BSS, Heap, Stack segments, Stack overflow |
| `02-data-types-and-stdint` | **Data Types & stdint** | Primitive types, format specifiers (`%d`, `%zu`), `<stdint.h>` (`uint32_t`, `int64_t`) |
| `03-pointers-and-pointer-arithmetic` | **Pointers Mastery** | Address-of (`&`), Dereference (`*`), Double pointers (`**`), `void*` generic pointers |
| `04-arrays-strings-and-decay` | **Arrays & Strings** | Array-to-pointer decay, null terminator (`\0`), string manipulation (`<string.h>`) |
| `05-dynamic-memory-heap-management` | **Dynamic Memory** | `malloc`, `calloc`, `realloc`, `free`, memory leaks, dangling pointers |
| `06-structs-unions-and-padding` | **Structs & Memory Alignment** | `struct`, `union`, memory alignment padding, `#pragma pack(1)`, bit-fields |
| `07-functions-and-function-pointers` | **Function Pointers** | Function declarations, recursion, function pointers, callbacks, `qsort` |
| `08-storage-classes-and-scope` | **Storage Classes** | `auto`, `register`, `static` (local persistence & file-scoping), `extern` |
| `09-type-qualifiers-const-volatile-restrict` | **Type Qualifiers** | `const`, `volatile` (hardware I/O registers), `restrict` (pointer aliasing optimization) |
| `10-c-preprocessor-macros` | **C Preprocessor** | `#define`, safe macro parentheses, `#` stringification, `##` token pasting |
| `11-bit-manipulation-and-bitwise-ops` | **Bit Manipulation** | Bitwise AND/OR/XOR/NOT/Shifts, Set/Clear/Toggle bits, Endianness detection |
| `12-file-handling-and-stdio` | **File I/O** | `fopen`, `fclose`, `fread`, `fwrite`, `fprintf`, `fscanf`, stream buffers |
| `13-error-handling-and-signals` | **Error & Signals** | `errno`, `perror`, `strerror`, POSIX signals (`<signal.h>`), `sigaction` |
| `14-concurrency-posix-threads-pthreads` | **POSIX Threads** | `pthread_create`, `pthread_join`, `pthread_mutex_t`, race conditions |
| `15-debugging-and-sanitizers` | **Debugging & Sanitizers** | AddressSanitizer (`-fsanitize=address,undefined`), Valgrind, GDB |
| `16-interview-questions-and-drills` | **Interview Master Drill** | Top 10 high-yield low-level C interview questions & memory traps |

---

## 🛠️ How to Compile & Run

Compile any module with gcc:
```bash
cd 00-setup-and-compilation-pipeline
gcc -std=c17 -Wall -Wextra main.c -o main
./main
```

# 00 - C Compilation Pipeline 🛠️

### The 4 Compilation Stages:
1. **Preprocessor (`gcc -E`)**: Expands `#include`, `#define`, strips comments -> `.i`
2. **Compiler (`gcc -S`)**: Translates C into assembly -> `.s`
3. **Assembler (`gcc -c`)**: Converts assembly into machine object code -> `.o`
4. **Linker (`gcc / ld`)**: Links object files with CRT and system libraries -> Executable

# 01 - Memory Layout of a C Program

- **Text Segment**: Read-only machine code.
- **Data Segment**: Initialized global/static variables.
- **BSS Segment**: Uninitialized global/static variables (zeroed at startup).
- **Heap**: Dynamic memory (`malloc`/`free`) growing upwards.
- **Stack**: Function stack frames (local variables) growing downwards.

# 05 - Dynamic Memory Allocation

- `malloc(size)`: Allocates raw bytes.
- `calloc(num, size)`: Allocates and zero-initializes memory.
- `realloc(ptr, new_size)`: Resizes existing block.
- `free(ptr)`: Releases heap memory back to allocator.

- `volatile`: Tells compiler variable can change unexpectedly (e.g. memory-mapped hardware).
- `restrict`: Compiler optimization asserting pointer exclusivity.
